computed_from_verified_canonical_inputs.note: value derived from verified canonical facts and committed artifacts

committed_computed_report.note: value read from a committed computed report (e.g. value profile risk profile, gap ledger)

external_manifest_only.note: value is an external-market observation carried by a manifest-only registry

bounded_search_complete.note: evidence from a completed bounded search (e.g. no repurchase event found within scope)

coverage_gap.note: component is not computable under the strict evidence contract; never zero

execution_rule.source_of_grade: each component's source_tier field in the v2 capsule is executed (looked up in the registry) to produce a per-component grade
execution_rule.dimension_aggregation: the dimension grade is the weakest (lowest) per-component grade among that dimension's components (fail-closed)
execution_rule.coverage_gap_reason: a component with source_tier coverage_gap contributes a specific reason and its gap_ids to supporting_ids
execution_rule.no_manual_grade: per-dimension grades are computed, never hand-assigned

prohibited_fallbacks: do not report a dimension grade without executing its component source tiers
do not let a coverage gap raise confidence
do not merge confidence into the score
do not conflate confidence with coverage gating

identity_inclusion.note: confidence report embeds the time-contract identity and the capsule digest so the confidence is bound to the exact observation set used
